info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Oracle WebLogic Server RESTful Management Services API
Edit
Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get edit configuration tree root

items.docs: Returns the root resource of the edit configuration tree. This provides links to all configurable resources in the domain.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Start an edit session

items.docs: Starts a new configuration edit session. Only one edit session can be active per user. The edit session locks the domain configuration for exclusive modification by the current user.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Activate pending changes

items.docs: Activates all pending configuration changes made during the current edit session. This distributes changes to all affected servers in the domain.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Cancel the current edit session

items.docs: Cancels the current edit session and discards all pending configuration changes.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Undo unactivated changes

items.docs: Reverts all unactivated changes within the current edit session without ending the session.

info.name: Domain Runtime
Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get domain runtime tree root

items.docs: Returns the root resource of the domain runtime MBean tree, providing links to runtime monitoring data and lifecycle operations across all servers in the domain.

items.docs: Returns runtime information for all running servers in the domain, accessed from the administration server.

info.name: Lifecycle
Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Start a managed server

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Starts the specified managed server.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Shut down a managed server

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Gracefully shuts down the specified managed server. In-flight work is completed before shutdown.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Force shut down a managed server

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Forces an immediate shutdown of the specified managed server without waiting for in-flight work to complete.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Suspend a managed server

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Suspends the specified managed server, transitioning it to ADMIN state where it only accepts administrative requests.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Resume a suspended managed server

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Resumes the specified managed server from ADMIN state back to RUNNING state, re-enabling it to accept client requests.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Restart SSL on a managed server

params.name: serverName
params.description: The name of the WebLogic Server instance

items.docs: Restarts the SSL listen sockets on the specified managed server, reloading SSL certificates and keys.
